* Cross\-Browser Testing: Test and debug web pages across different browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) and screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile).
* **Maintenance \& Updates: Assist in updating existing website content, fixing layout bugs, and improving page performance and accessibility (W3C/WCAG standards).**  Collaboration: Work closely with senior developers, UI/UX designers, and content teams to deliver assigned web tasks on schedule.
* **Version Control: Maintain and submit code changes using Git and GitHub.**
* **Tamil candidates only**
